start.text: Taxi, sir-madam! Whitefield? AC car, direct, no stopping. Eighteen hundred only.

choices.text: Eighteen hundred?! The bus is two-fifty.

counter.text: Bus will take two hours, boss, three hours in traffic. Okay okay — prepaid counter is nine hundred. Nine hundred and you sit in comfort.

farewell.text: Fine, fine. Go in the bus. When you are tired of Bengaluru buses, you will come find me.
